adaptations: Pruning-manifest entries train a fresh full model using recorded original settings rather than importing a historical dense checkpoint.
New supplied input samples use declared linear interpolation; the historical analytic benchmark waveform is not imported.
Feature scales and Gaussian locations are resolved from the newly supplied raw training observations.
Timed stopping and hardware speed can change the selected model; these recipes do not promise bitwise historical replay.
